propositions: A single mapped project's base-query transport error (ACLI 400/401/403/404/429/5xx/timeout) currently aborts the entire reconciler pass for all projects instead of isolating the failure
The base-query loop lacks per-project error isolation that already exists in the enrichment loop (_enrich_project), causing whole-pass abort on one project's failure to propagate to all others
Extracting _fetch_project helper to drain both base queries into a local dict and merge atomically only on success prevents partial keys from the failed project reaching the shared snapshot
Per-project transport errors must emit fetcher-project-fetch-failed alerts and continue to other projects, while invalid keys remain fail-closed and BackendPaginationStallError still re-raises
Single-project fallback path must retain fail-closed regression parity and never write empty all-deletions snapshots as a side effect of per-project isolation
